entries.text: 1 2W PUMP SYSTEM SHALL INCLUDE (2) FACTORY JUNCTION BOXES WITH CORD STRAIN / RELIEF GRIPS FOR CABLES. PROVIDE ONE JBOX FOR THE MOTOR CABLES AND ONE / FOR THE FLOAT SWITCHES. ROUTE POWER RACEWAY TO MCC BUCKETS, AND / CONTROL WIRING TO PLC CONTROL PANEL.
2 PROVIDE FACTORY FLOAT TREE ASSEMBLY WITH 4 FLOATS.

3 PROVIDE HEAT TRACE ON ALL EXPOSED PIPING. RAY-CHEM BTV SELF REGULATING / HEATING CABLE, OR EQUAL. SYSTEM SHALL INCLUDE GFEP BREAKER ON 120V 20AMP / DEDICATED CIRCUIT. PROVIDE NEMA 4X THERMOSTAT AND END OF LINE TERMINATION / KIT WITH INDICATOR LIGHT.

4 2W FLOW METER: 1" MAGNETIC FLOW METER, ENDRESS-HAUSER PROMAG W400, / CLASS I DIV 2, CARBON STEEL FLANGE, 24VAC/DC, ETHERNET/IP, POLYURETHANE / LINER, 316L ELECTRODES, LOCAL DISPLAY, NEMA 4X, NPT 1 PROVIDE (2) 316L / GROUNDING RINGS FOR EACH FLOW TUBE.
5 ROUTE POWER WIRING FOR SOLENOID AND HEAT TRACE CIRCUITS TO JBOX IN HB#1 / AND EXTEND TO HB#2.
